summary: Story-level roll-up for ask-period-control. All three performance passes finished with zero blocking findings. One real non-blocking finding was raised and FIXED rather than carried: a successful statement answer ran the same ingest_batch query twice, once through resolver.options() and again inside resolver.resolve(); resolve() now takes an optional knownPeriods and the Ask path hands back the list it has already loaded. Deliberately not a cache - scopeValueCacheTtlMs defaults to five minutes, long enough that after an ingest the report would keep offering periods that no longer exist. A second finding was REJECTED with evidence: it asked windowMatchesPeriod to compare a grain that AppliedTimeWindow does not carry, which would have broken the single-day-versus-whole-month equivalence the matcher exists for; the neighbouring real gap it pointed at - the matcher ignoring the time column - was fixed instead.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [ask-period-contract-and-branch] [P2] Include the requested grain when matching a period option (backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:812): `windowMatchesPeriod` compares only dates.

residual_risks: A live period SWITCH is unproven end to end: the warehouse holds one loaded actuals month, so the control offers a single option. Covered hermetically by three leaves.
